articleTitle: Clinical effectiveness and economic evaluation of acupoint injection for the treatment of primary insomnia: a systematic review and network meta-analysis.
takeaways: This study analyzed acupoint injection therapy, which combines traditional acupuncture points with pharmaceutical injections, as a treatment approach for primary insomnia that affects sleep quality
The research established comparative rankings of different acupoint injection therapies to determine which specific variations showed superior effectiveness for treating primary insomnia
Acupoint injection demonstrated both clinical effectiveness and economic value as a treatment option, suggesting it may be a cost-efficient alternative to conventional insomnia treatments
The study provided evidence-based support for acupoint injection's dual mechanism of combining pharmacological effects with acupuncture stimulation at specific body points
This systematic review and network meta-analysis offers clinicians ranked treatment options within acupoint injection therapies, enabling more targeted selection for individual insomnia patients
